name: David Young
role: Full Stack Engineer @ Yoco | Building Dyner | MSc(Eng) Candidate
bio: I am a Full Stack Engineer at Yoco, building Dyner: an AI-native operating system for restaurants and independent businesses. My work spans product and platform engineering, including frontend applications, backend services, cloud infrastructure, data workflows, and production system foundations. Alongside this, I am completing an MSc in Electrical Engineering at the University of Cape Town, where I am re-architecting FERS, a modern C++ radar simulation platform focused on performance, extensibility, and usability.
